mil5.3.3:3.1: Puna ca Tathāgato catunnaṃ parisānaṃ majjhe nisīditvā purato devamanussānaṃ Selassa brāhmaṇassa kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ dassesi.
mil5.3.3:3.3: Kāyena saṃvaro sādhūti, tena hi: Selassa brāhmaṇassa kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ dassesīti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.3.3:3.4: Yadi Selassa brāhmaṇassa kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ dassesi, tena hi: Kāyena saṃvaro sādhūti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.3.3:3.5: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.3.3:4.1: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā: Kāyena saṃvaro sādhūti. Selassa ca brāhmaṇassa kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ dassitaṃ.
mil5.3.3:4.2: Yassa kho mahārāja Tathāgate kankhā uppannā tassa bodhanatthāya Bhagavā iddhiyā tappaṭibhāgaṃ kāyaṃ dasseti, so yeva taṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ passatīti. -
mil5.3.3:5.1: Ko pan' etaṃ bhante Nāgasena saddahissati yaṃ parisagato eko yeva taṃ guyhaṃ passati, avasesā tatth' eva santā na passanti.
mil5.3.3:5.2: Ingha me tvaṃ tattha kāraṇaṃ upadisa, kāraṇena maṃ saññāpehīti. -
mil5.3.3:5.3: Diṭṭhapubbo pana tayā mahārāja koci byādhito puriso parikiṇṇo ñātimittehīti. -
mil5.3.3:5.5: Api nu kho mahārāja parisā passat' etaṃ vedanaṃ yāya so puriso vedanāya vediyatīti. -
mil5.3.3:5.6: Na hi bhante, attanā yeva so bhante puriso vediyatīti. -
mil5.3.3:5.7: Evam-eva kho mahārāja yass' eva Tathāgate kankhā uppannā tass' eva Tathāgato bodhanāya iddhiyā tappaṭibhāgaṃ kāyaṃ dasseti, so yeva taṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ passati.
mil5.3.3:6.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja kañcid-eva purisaṃ bhūto āviseyya, api nu kho sā mahārāja parisā passati taṃ bhūtagāhan-ti. -
mil5.3.3:6.2: Na hi bhante, so yeva āturo tassa bhūtassa āgamanaṃ passatīti. -
mil5.3.3:6.3: Evameva kho mahārāja yass' eva Tathāgate kankhā uppannā so yeva taṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ passatīti. -
mil5.3.3:7.1: Dukkaraṃ bhante Nāgasena Bhagavatā kataṃ yaṃ ekassa pi adassanīyaṃ taṃ dassentenāti. -
mil5.3.3:7.2: Na mahārāja Bhagavā guyhaṃ dassesi, iddhiyā pana chāyaṃ dassesīti. -
mil5.3.3:7.3: Chāyāya pi bhante diṭṭhāya diṭṭhaṃ yeva hoti guyhaṃ yaṃ disvā niṭṭhaṃ gato ti. -
mil5.3.3:7.4: Dukkarañ-cāpi mahārāja Tathāgato karoti bodhaneyye satte bodhetuṃ.
mil5.3.3:7.5: Yadi mahārāja Tathāgato kiriyaṃ kiriyaṃ hāpeyya, bodhaneyyā sattā na bujjheyyuṃ;
mil5.3.3:7.6: yasmā ca kho mahārāja yogaññū Tathāgato bodhaneyye bodhetuṃ, tasmā Tathāgato yena yena yogena bodhaneyyā bujjhanti tena tena yogena bodhaneyye bodheti.
mil5.3.3:8.1: Yathā mahārāja bhisakko sallakatto yena yena bhesajjena āturo arogo hoti tena tena bhesajjena āturaṃ upasaṅkamati: vamanīyaṃ vameti, virecanīyaṃ vireceti, anulepanīyaṃ anulimpeti, anuvāsanīyaṃ anuvāseti;
mil5.3.3:8.2: evameva kho mahārāja Tathāgato yena yena yogena bodhaneyyā sattā bujjhanti tena tena yogena bodheti.
mil5.3.3:9.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja itthī mūḷhagabbhā bhisakkassa adassanīyaṃ guyhaṃ dasseti,
mil5.3.3:9.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgato bodhaneyye bodhetuṃ adassanīyaṃ guyhaṃ iddhiyā chāyaṃ dassesi.
mil5.3.3:9.3: Na-tthi mahārāja adassanīyo nāma okāso puggalaṃ upādāya.
mil5.3.3:9.4: Yadi mahārāja kaci Bhagavato hadayaṃ disvā bujjheyya, tassa pi Bhagavā yogena hadayaṃ dasseyya. Yogaññū mahārāja Tathāgato desanākusalo.
mil5.3.3:10.1: Nanu mahārāja Tathāgato therassa Nandassa adhimuttiṃ jānitvā taṃ devabhavanaṃ netvā devakaññāyo dassesi: iminā 'yaṃ kulaputto bujjhissatīti, tena ca so kulaputto bujjhi.
mil5.3.3:10.2: Iti kho mahārāja Tathāgato anekapariyāyena subhanimittaṃ hīḷento garahanto jigucchanto tassa bodhanahetu kakuṭapādiniyo accharāyo dassesi.
mil5.3.3:11.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja Tathāgato therassa Cullapanthakassa bhātarā nikkaḍḍhitassa dukkhitassa dummanassa upagantvā sukhumaṃ coḷakhaṇḍaṃ adāsi: iminā 'yaṃ kulaputto bujjhissatīti, so ca kulaputto tena kāraṇena Jinasāsane vasībhāvaṃ pāpuṇi.
mil5.3.3:12.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja Tathāgato brāhmaṇassa Mogharājassa yāvatatiyaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākāsi: evam-imassa kulaputtassa māno upasamissati, mānūpasamā abhisamayo bhavissatīti, tena ca tassa kulaputtassa māno upasami, mānūpasamā so brāhmaṇo chasu abhiññāsu vasībhāvaṃ pāpuṇi.
mil5.3.3:13.1: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, sunibbeṭhito pañho bahuvidhehi kāraṇehi, gahanaṃ agahanaṃ kataṃ, andhakāro āloko kato, gaṇṭhi bhinno, bhaggā parappavādā, Jinaputtānaṃ cakkhuṃ tayā uppāditaṃ, nippaṭibhānā titthiyā, tvaṃ gaṇivarapavaraṃ āsajjāti.
